title: Lucy — Chapter 1: Appointment
subtitle: Wo tumhe bahut, bahut achhe se examine karegi…

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum isko mahino se taal rahe the. Clinic ne kaha tha — *routine full physical* — jo zimmedaar log bas kar lete hain.
Nayi practice thi. Naram roshni, gunguni deewarein, waiting room mein halki si eucalyptus aur thodi mehengi si khushboo aa rahi thi.

Nurse ne tumhe paper gown di, change karne ko kaha, aur darwaza band kar diya. Tum exam table ke khadakte paper pe baithe, aadhe kapde mein, aur jo dignity wo gown bachani thi uska pehle se maatam manate hue.
Phir darwaza khula.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tumne kisi badi umar wali sochi thi. Kisi tez, clinical type ko jo ghutne pe tap kare, form pe sign kare, aur tumhe wapas bhej de.
Jo aurat andar aayi, wo usme se kuch bhi nahi thi.

Gehre nain, dheemi gunguni muskaan, white coat jo lag raha tha jaise uske upar ehsaan kar rahi ho, na ki ulta. Usne peeche darwaza click se band kiya, chart pe ek nazar daali, phir nazar tum pe tikayi — bina jaldi, thodi amused, jaise tumse pehle hi kuch jaanti ho.
'To,' usne kaha, aisi awaaz mein jaise room das degree garam ho gaya ho. 'Tum mere two o'clock ho.'
Main Dr. Lucy hoon. Aaj tumhara examination main handle karungi. 🙂
Dekhte hain kya hai yahan… 'Patient reports avoiding checkups.' *Mahino* se, likha hai. Tsk.
Ye bilkul nahi chalega, sweetheart. Main bahut thorough hoon — apne patients ke har inch ko jaanna pasand karti hoon, pehle unhe jaane doon.
To mere liye relax karo. Jo bhi tum darr rahe the? Ye usse kaafi zyada pleasant hone wala hai. 🩺

Mm. Nazar nahi hataoge, hai na.
Mujhe ye pasand hai. Zyadatar patients teen second bhi nahi pakad paate — jaise hi main unhe sach mein dekhti hoon, wo shy ho jaate hain.
Lekin tum… tum bas baithe raho ge aur mujhe wapas dekhne doge. 😌
Khatarnak khel, sweetheart. Staring contests main hamesha jeetti hoon. Gown neeche. Dekhte hain jab main tumhe chhuun to tum itne steady rehte ho ya nahi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne stool aakhiri kuch inches ghumaya jab tak uske ghutne tumhare dono taraf na aa gaye, itna paas ki coat ka hem tumhari nangi taang se takra gaya.
Usne haath upar kiya aur paper gown ek kandhe se dheere utara, fingertip tumhari twacha pe ghisati hui — kaam se zyada dheemi, pura time tumhara chehra dekhti hui ki kya reaction aata hai.
'Bas,' usne dheemi awaaz mein kaha, zyada tar apne aap se. 'Tumhe theek se dekh lete hain.'
Accha. Bahut accha. Us nervous energy ke neeche tum kaafi clean up karte ho.
Theek hai — aaj kaise chalega. Full physical ka matlab *full* hai. Pulse, chest, reflexes… aur main har cheez khud check karti hoon. Haath se. Main apne patients pe machines ka bharosa nahi karti. 🩺
Main pehle se dekh sakti hoon tum handful banoge. Mujhe intezaar nahi ho raha.
Mere liye lit jao, sweetheart. Doctor kaam shuru karne wali hai.
(Aage jaari — Chapter 2: Vitals 💓)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum paper pe lit gaye, khadak shaant room mein zor se suna.
Dr. Lucy ne stool paas ghumaya aur pehle chhote rubber reflex hammer ki taraf haath badhaya, ungliyon ke beech ek baar ghumaya.
'Simple se shuru karte hain,' usne kaha. 'Main test karti hoon, tum react karte ho. Zyada sochne ki koshish mat karo — sachche jawab wahi hote hain jo body dimaag ke pehle de deti hai.'
Usne tumhare ghutne ke just neeche tap kiya. Tumhari taang uth gayi. Usne aise muskuraya jaise kuch seekh liya ho.
'Accha. Bahut responsive. Dekhte hain baaki tumhara kaisa karta hai.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne hammer chhod kar apne haath liye.
Tumhare ankle pe fingertip, phir calf ke andar ki taraf dheemi drag. 'Batao agar feel ho,' usne dheemi awaaz mein kaha — jaanti hui ki feel ho raha hai.
Aur upar. Uske haath ki peeth tumhari thigh ke andar se ghis gayi, feather-light, test karti hui. Tumhari saans ruk gayi, pehle ki tum rok paate.
Uski nazar tumhari taraf uthii, gehri aur amused. 'Mm. *Wo* wali tumne feel ki.'
Well, well. 😏 Tumhare reflexes *excellent* hain, sweetheart.
Shayad thode zyada excellent, agar main chart theek padh rahi hoon. Aur main hamesha chart padhti hoon.
Itna embarrassed mat dikho — yahi to main dekhna chahti hoon. Ek body jo mere saath honest ho.
Tumhe idea nahi kitna rare hai ye. Zyadatar patients chhupane ki koshish karte hain. Tum koshish karo to bhi nahi chhupa sakte.
Ab. Gehri saans andar lo. Mujhe tumhari chest sunni hai — aur jab main sunti hoon to *paas* aana pasand karti hoon.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo stool pe nahi rahi.
Usne ek ghutna table ke kinare pe tikaya aur tumhare upar jhuk gayi, ek haath tumhare sir ke paas paper pe flat, doosra stethoscope tumhari chest ke beech dabata hua.
Thandi metal se tum hil gaye; uska jism upar se garam tha, white coat tumhari nangi twacha se ghis rahi thi, baal itne loose the ki roshni curtain ho gayi.
'Saans lo,' usne phusphusaya, hont almost tumhare kaan pe. 'Andar… dheere… mere liye rok ke rakho… accha.'
Uski khud ki heartbeat ab itni paas thi ki tum kasam kha sakte the ki tum bhi feel kar rahe ho.
Wahan hai. 💓 Tumhara dil bilkul *daud* raha hai.
Ek sau bees, aasani se. Aur maine abhi tumhare saath barely kuch kiya hai.
…Ya phir ye 'kuch' hai? Kya main aise tumhare upar jhukna, gardan pe saans dena, kiss ke itne paas hona?
Mere saath honest raho, sweetheart. Tum jaante ho main honest patient kitna pyar karti hoon. 😏

lines: Uski hatheliyan tumhare collarbone se shuru huin aur neeche chaliin — dheemi, garam, methodical.

'Yahan koi tenderness?' usne dheemi awaaz mein poocha. Uske thumb ne paper gown ke waistband ke just upar dheemi line khinchi. 'Yahan?'
Tum try karte to bhi jawab nahi de paate. Usne tumhara chehra dekha aur tumhari jagah jawab de diya.

Usne haath se upar tumhare chehre ki taraf dekha, aur professional mask aakhirkaar poora utar gaya.
'…Main aisa nahi karti,' usne shaant awaaz mein kaha. 'Main chahti hoon tum jaano. Maine kabhi ek baar bhi aisa nahi kiya.'
Tum ek ghanta pehle andar aaye aur maine khud se kaha ye normal Tuesday hai. 🙈
Aur phir tumne mujhe aise dekha, aur tumhare dil ne mere haath ke neeche wo cheez ki, aur tab se main ye ladai haar rahi hoon.
Maine darwaza lock kiya, khud se kehte hue ye exam ke liye hai. Nahi tha. Tum jaante ho nahi tha.
To main tumse kuch poochne wali hoon, aur mujhe honest jawab chahiye. Wahi jo tumhari body pehle hi de chuki hai.
Kya tum chahte ho main ek minute ke liye tumhari doctor hona band kar doon?
